home.title: Soft skin starts here
home.subtitle: Body, face and intimate sugaring in a private Duchess Street studio — gentle on skin, done right the first time.
home.why1Body: Just sugar, lemon and water — no synthetic resins, no harsh chemicals against your skin.
home.why2Body: Applied against hair growth and removed with it, so hair breaks less and grows back finer.
home.why3Body: A fresh scoop of paste for every pass, in a clean, private one-on-one studio.
home.step1Body: Choose your treatment and pick a time that works for you — confirmed instantly.

home.step4Body: A calming finish smooths the skin, with results that typically last four to five weeks.

about.title: A gentler way to remove hair
about.paragraph1: Soft Touch Aesthetics Studio is a private body sugaring studio on Duchess Street in Saskatoon, offering hair removal made from nothing more than sugar, lemon and water.
about.paragraph2: Sugar paste is applied against the direction of hair growth and lifted away with it — gentler on skin than traditional waxing, with less breakage and fewer ingrown hairs over time.
about.paragraph3: The studio is woman-owned, clean and private, with every appointment given full, unhurried attention from start to finish.
about.ctaBody: See the full treatment menu or book your appointment directly online.
about.heroSub: Private body sugaring on Duchess Street, Saskatoon.
about.noteCard: Sugar, lemon, water — that's the whole recipe. Nothing artificial, ever.
about.visitBody: No surprises. Here is every step, start to finish.
about.step1Body: A private entrance and one client at a time. No waiting room, no overlap with anyone else.
about.step2Body: Your skin, any sensitivities, and what you want done. If it is your first time, say so — it is welcome and completely normal.
about.step3Body: Warm paste at body temperature, worked in sections against the direction of growth. You set the pace and we stop whenever you ask.
about.step4Body: Written aftercare to take with you, and rebooking whenever you are ready — never before.

prepare.before1: Hair should be approximately ¼ inch long (about 2–3 weeks after shaving).
prepare.before2: Gently exfoliate 24–48 hours before your appointment.
prepare.before3: Avoid applying lotions or oils on the day of your appointment.
prepare.before4: Wear loose, comfortable clothing if possible.
prepare.before5: Skip retinol products and sunless tanner for 48 hours beforehand.
prepare.afterIntro: To keep your skin looking its best:
prepare.afterTip: Resume gentle exfoliation after a few days to help reduce ingrown hairs.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.heroSub: Everything clients ask before their first appointment.
faq.stillBody: Send us a note and we'll get back to you.
faq.a1: Some discomfort is normal, especially during your first appointment, but many clients find sugaring gentler than traditional waxing.
faq.q2: How long should my hair be?
faq.a2: About ¼ inch (approximately the length of a grain of rice).
faq.a3: For the best results, avoid shaving between sugaring appointments.
faq.q5: Can I get sugared during my period?
faq.a5: Yes. Many clients do. We simply recommend wearing a fresh tampon or menstrual cup.
faq.q6: Is sugaring suitable for sensitive skin?
faq.a6: Yes. Sugaring is often preferred for sensitive skin because it is made from natural ingredients and is less likely to irritate the skin than traditional waxing.
